info.desc: "The Battle of Los Angeles" is the third and final studio album by American rock band Rage Against the Machine, released by Epic Records on November 2, 1999. At the 43rd Annual Grammy Awards, the album was nominated for Best Rock Album, and the song "Guerrilla Radio" received the award for Best Hard Rock Performance. In year-end rankings, both Time and Rolling Stone listed the album among their top releases of 1999. The album was certified double platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America, indicating sales of at least two million units in the United States. It was the .

podcast.body: Released on November 2, 1999, one day short of the seventh anniversary of their first record. Like their previous album, it debuted at number one on the album charts, notably preventing Mariah Carey's album from reaching the top spot. This album showcased Tom Morello's unique guitar playing style, characterized by the use of various effects and the powerful "space between the notes." "The third Rage Against the Machine album was called The Battle of Los Angeles. It came out on November 2nd 1999... And like the last album, it debuted at number 1 on the album charts."
